create_stanford_lightfield_dataset: create a StanfordLightfieldDataset instance with a config object and train split for lightfield data loading
read_meta_camera_coords: read metadata from Stanford lightfield images to extract camera coordinates from file paths
normalize_coord_camera: normalize a camera coordinate to a standardized range using the dataset camera range and aspect ratio
get_rays_lightfield: get lightfield rays for a given spatial and temporal index using normalized camera coordinates
get_rgb_image: get an RGB image tensor for a given spatial and temporal index from the Stanford lightfield dataset
